note: Ratchet for the structural code report (`./gradlew :peer:structureReport`). Every number below is production code that ships and does nothing: classes nothing references, methods only tests call, methods no entry point can reach, methods too big for the JIT, and severe in-loop cost findings. They may only go DOWN — raising a limit to make a build green defeats the point of measuring, so a rise fails the task. The task prints the tightened set whenever the tree improves; paste it here in the same commit.
measured:
2026-08-10 on branch `feat/cross-folia-region-commit-#179` (base ee6d61f), by `./gradlew :peer:structureReport`. **Two limits RISE here, and this is the reason.** test_only_methods 309 -> 312 and unreachable_methods 112 -> 117; dead_classes, test_only_classes, never_referenced_methods, huge_methods and severe_cost_findings are all unchanged, and never_referenced_methods stays at 2 with no headroom.

The eight findings are enumerable and they are exactly one thing: **stage 2 of the cross-Folia-region commit (server task 4 deliverable 6, L-64), which has no production caller because nothing on the plugin path delegates a region yet (server tasks 2 and 3).** test_only: CrossRegionCommit#commit, CrossRegionCommit#joint, CrossRegionCommit.RegionPark#<init>. unreachable: CrossRegionCommit#parkOn, #resume, #rootCause, #runCommit and CrossRegionCommit.Parked#<init> -- the rendezvous internals that only #commit reaches. Nothing else in the tree moved.

Stage 1 is NOT in that list, and that is deliberate. The gate, the region map and the ownership probe are reachable from `NoderaEndpointPlugin.onEnable`, which now runs the live ALIGN-1 self-check server task 3 asks for: it exercises `requireJointCriticalSection` on the regions that nest in one Folia section and on one a section away, and logs what the gate actually did on the exponent this server is running. Three genuinely unused accessors were DELETED rather than stamped (CrossRegionRefusedException#source/#target/#transferId, and NoderaFoliaRegionMap#gridExponent + TransferStoreJournal#store, which were never_referenced); `NoderaFoliaRegionMap#sameSection` became private.

**When this comes back down.** Server tasks 2 and 3 put a delegated region on the plugin path; the delta path then calls `CrossRegionCommit.commit`, and all eight findings become reachable in the same commit that retires L-64's live half. If that does not happen, the correct response is to delete stage 2, not to leave this stamp standing -- which is what this note exists to make checkable.
